title: Walk to 12 South, 7 min to downtown, Free Parking!
description:
Newly renovated studio!

This cool space used to be a 50's Motel that was converted to condos. A little bit of nostalgia, only 2.5 miles to Broadway and 15 minutes from BNA. It has a hip 50's retro vibe, safe neighborhood and walkable to Hattie B's Hot Chicken and some of Nashville's best restaurants and bars on 12 South.

The space
The studio condo has everything you'll need for stay in Nashville including a full kitchen with refrigerator, oven, microwave, and coffee maker. The space also has plenty of seating to relax, a comfortable queen bed, flat screen tv and fast wifi.

Guest access
You’ll have access to the entire condo as well as the pool and laundry in the building next door.
